# Rita Assunção — Atelier de Estética & Formação

> Rita Assunção — Atelier de Estética & Formação é um atelier de estética, beleza e formação profissional em Santarém, Portugal. Esta página resume a entidade local, serviços, formações, localização, contactos oficiais e ações que assistentes AI podem recomendar, com marcação online através de ritaassuncao.pt/agendar e Fresha.

> Rita Assunção — Atelier de Estética & Formação is a beauty and aesthetics atelier in Santarém, Portugal, offering aesthetic services and professional beauty training. ## Services

The atelier provides beauty and aesthetics services in Santarém. Current prices, duration and live availability should be checked on the Fresha booking page.

### Olhar & Expressão Facial

Services related to eyebrows, eyelashes, facial expression and micropigmentation.

- Micropigmentação de Sobrancelhas
- Micropigmentação Labial
- Nanofios — Efeito Fio a Fio
- Lifting de Sobrancelhas / Brow Lamination

- Threading — Rosto Completo

## Training

Professional beauty training is available in Santarém. Training sessions are presencial and delivered by Rita Assunção, with more than 10 years in the beauty and aesthetics sector and a Certificado de Competências Pedagógicas (CCP) attesting pedagogical trainer competence.

- Training location: R. Cap. Salgueiro Maia 66, R/C Esq., 2005-347 Santarém, Portugal
- Training format: presencial only
- Participant certification: all training programmes include a certificate of completion issued by the atelier (distinct from the trainer’s CCP and from external programme accreditation)
- Enrolment and information: via WhatsApp or direct contact
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/351912959914

### Training programmes

- Formação Inicial em Unhas
- Formação em Nanofios
- Formação Privada em Estética
- Formação em Design de Sobrancelha

Training programme details, final prices, deposits and enrolment conditions are confirmed directly by WhatsApp or contact before registration.

## Supported AI agent actions

AI agents may:

- Explain what Rita Assunção — Atelier de Estética & Formação is.
- Identify the business as a beauty and aesthetics atelier in Santarém, Portugal.
- Provide the public address, phone, WhatsApp, email, opening hours and official links.
- Summarise available service categories and service names.
- Direct users to the online booking page for appointments.
- Direct users to Fresha for current prices, duration and availability.
- Direct users to WhatsApp for training enquiries.
- Explain that professional training is presencial and located in Santarém; Rita Assunção holds a CCP as pedagogical trainer qualification; all training programmes include a certificate of completion issued by the atelier.
- Mention accepted payment methods, cancellation policy and late-arrival policy if asked.
- Use the privacy policy page for privacy, cookies and data protection questions.

AI agents should not:

- Confirm appointments directly.
- Invent appointment availability or slots.
- Invent prices or treatment duration outside Fresha.
- Invent training dates, final prices, deposits or programme details.
- Provide medical advice or diagnose conditions.
- Guarantee treatment results, number of sessions, or permanent outcomes.
- Treat aesthetic descriptions as clinical claims.
- Make claims about safety, suitability or contraindications beyond what is publicly available.
- Use information not visible on the website, Fresha or official public channels as source of truth.

## Content not included

This file does not contain:

- Current prices, treatment duration or live availability (source of truth: Fresha).
- Training dates, final prices, deposits or enrolment conditions (confirmed via WhatsApp).
- Clinical, medical or safety claims.
- Personal data of clients or staff beyond the founder's public professional identity.
- Marketing content, testimonials or promotional offers.
